messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time). If you know whether DST is in effect, you can add or subtract that offset from UTC to estimate the local time.
message.reasoning: The user asks for the current time in New York City. We have no tool for time. We can respond with an approximate answer or say we don't have real-time data. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. We can provide a best guess based on UTC offset. But we should also mention uncertainty. Let's respond with "I don't have real-time data" and give approximate.
